description: This file contains Go source code implementing a command to recursively remove focus markers from Ginkgo test files, including functions for directory traversal, file parsing, AST analysis, and file modification.

methods.name: BuildUnfocusCommand
methods.description: Constructs and returns a command object for the 'unfocus' operation.

methods.name: unfocusSpecs
methods.description: Initiates the process of scanning and unfocusing test files.

methods.name: unfocusDir
methods.description: Recursively traverses directories to find Go files to process.

methods.name: shouldProcessDir
methods.description: Determines if a directory should be processed based on its name.

methods.name: shouldProcessFile
methods.description: Checks if a file has a '.go' extension for processing.

methods.name: unfocusFile
methods.description: Reads, parses, scans, backs up, and updates a Go source file to remove focus markers.

methods.name: writeBackup
methods.description: Creates a temporary backup of the original file data.

methods.name: updateFile
methods.description: Rewrites the file content after removing focus markers based on AST analysis.

methods.name: scanForFocus
methods.description: Analyzes the AST of a Go file to find focus markers for removal.

methods.name: isFocus
methods.description: Checks if a given identifier name is a focus marker.
